picks.editorial_note: NASA's formal entry into the Genesis Mission — a whole-of-government initiative launched by executive order spanning 15+ federal agencies — signals the broadest and most consequential policy commitment behind this week's wave of AI-for-science funding.
picks.title: NASA Joins Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI-Driven Discovery - NASA

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's role leading 13 Genesis Mission projects and partnering on 30+ more makes it the single largest institutional footprint in the DOE's national AI-for-science push this week.
picks.title: Berkeley Lab to Lead 13 New Genesis Mission AI Projects

picks.editorial_note: Oak Ridge National Laboratory leading nine Genesis Mission projects and contributing to 32 others underscores the scale of national-lab coordination behind the initiative.
picks.title: Department of Energy selects ORNL to lead nine Genesis Mission projects | ORNL

picks.editorial_note: Sandia's selection to lead six Genesis Mission projects and partner on 17 more reflects the depth of national-lab involvement in DOE's AI, supercomputing, and quantum research agenda.
picks.title: Sandia selected to lead six Genesis Mission projects, partner on 17 others

picks.editorial_note: CuspAI's £330 million raise at a £2 billion valuation, with an Imperial College London scientist as Chief Scientific Officer, is a major private-sector validation of academic AI-for-materials research.
picks.title: Imperial expert leads science at £2 billion AI materials company CuspAI

picks.editorial_note: Penn State's $20 million NSF award to lead a national 'programmable cloud laboratory' node marks a significant, well-funded push toward automated, AI-driven scientific experimentation infrastructure.
picks.title: Penn State awarded $20M to lead an NSF ‘programmable cloud laboratory’ | Penn State University

picks.editorial_note: TUM and MIT's expanded AI and robotics partnership, with researchers rotating between MIRMI and CSAIL, represents a deepening transatlantic academic collaboration backed by direct government funding.
picks.title: TUM and MIT are expanding their strategic partnership in the fields of AI and robotics. The Bavarian Ministry of Science is providing 1.6 million.

picks.editorial_note: EPFL, ETH Zurich, and CSCS's release of Apertus 1.5 — a fully open, multimodal large language model trained on a national supercomputer — is a notable scientific and infrastructure milestone for open AI development in Europe.
picks.title: Apertus 1.5: Building the next generation of open AI infrastructure

picks.editorial_note: A new deep learning model from CMU, Pitt, and UW researchers revealing how 3D genome architecture differs in Alzheimer's patients is a genuine scientific advance with direct implications for neurodegenerative disease research.
picks.title: AI, Single-Cell Technology Reveal How 3D Genome Differs in People With Alzheimer's Disease

picks.editorial_note: UC Riverside's SAGA tool, developed with YouTube and Google DeepMind, can trace AI-generated fake videos to their source model — a practical breakthrough with real-world impact on combating disinformation.
picks.title: New tool identifies the sources of fake videos
